name: apple-notes
description: Inspect, search, create, edit, move, and organize notes in Apple Notes on macOS.
long_description: Local MCP server for Apple Notes on macOS. Uses AppleScript as the primary bridge to list accounts and folders, inspect notes, search note contents, create and update notes, move notes between folders, and organize notes while keeping Notes as the system of record.

notes_safety_mode.title: Notes safety mode
notes_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: read and search notes only. safe_manage: also create, edit, move, and delete notes and folders. full_access: same as safe_manage. This bundle's default is full_access. Sets APPLE_NOTES_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.

notes_allowed_accounts.title: Allowed Notes accounts
notes_allowed_accounts.description: Optional comma-separated Notes account names the assistant may use. Leave empty for all accounts. Sets APPLE_NOTES_MCP_ALLOWED_ACCOUNTS.

notes_allowed_folders.title: Allowed Notes folders
notes_allowed_folders.description: Optional comma-separated Notes folder names the assistant may use. Leave empty for all folders. Sets APPLE_NOTES_MCP_ALLOWED_FOLDERS.

tools.name: get_tool_info
tools.description: Read the schema and usage of an available tool.
